Zelensky Says Ukraine Sank Russian Warship at Naval Base in Libya

Ukraine sank a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya using naval drones, said Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky . Forces deployed seven Ukrainian-made drones that struck and sank the Russian corvette Mercury, which was carrying a combat helicopter, Zelensky said Monday morning.
